name: freechain
description: The complete FreeChain dashboard and OpenAI-compatible failover engine, managed by Kiro Crew.
author: Purple Industries
highlights: Bundled engine: no standalone FreeChain process required
All eight dashboard pages with live Crew theme inheritance
Private provider keys, harnesses, presets, and request logs
Ready-to-use CLI for Crew agents and local automation
configuration: Enable FreeChain in Crew Library and grant app trust when requested.
Add provider keys on Providers. This app keeps independent settings and credentials.
Local keys shows the app-owned API endpoint. The bundled CLI discovers the running engine automatically.
